issues: Percentage labels (72%, 75%, 67%) are white ~9px text inside an 8px green/orange bar (white on #10b981 ~2.5:1, on orange ~2:1); on 0% cards the green '0%' sits on a pale grey track. Move the % outside the bar as 13px+ text at >=4.5:1 and make the bar purely decorative (aria-hidden, with the value in text)

Folder status is colour-only: the green, orange and grey dots plus orange '2 lists inside' text carry the over-75% warning with no word or icon. Add a text label such as 'Near cap' and an icon, and keep the count text neutral

The kebab menu on each card is a ~16x16px icon with no visible label. Raise the hit area to at least 24x24px (44px on touch), add an aria-label like 'More actions for <folder>' and show a visible focus ring

Cap amounts, breadcrumbs, the 'REPOSITORIES' header, search placeholder and card subtitles are light grey (~#9aa0ad) at 11-12px, which falls below 4.5:1 on white and #f8f9fb. Darken muted text to at least #6b7280
Money is set in monospace grey ('€2.50M', 'Set cap'). Use proportional tabular numerals with full contrast, and give 'Set cap' a real button look instead of plain grey text
The grid/list toggle and the sidebar collapse are icon-only ~28px controls whose active state is only a subtle white fill. Add aria-pressed, a tooltip label and a stronger selected indicator

On mobile the header packs a hamburger, search, a bare upload icon button and the avatar, and the upload button has no text. Label it, and drop the stray vertical divider after 'Open All', which now wraps alone
The sidebar 'Allocated Budget' widget repeats the low-contrast white-in-bar '72%' at 9px
The '72%' on the total bar and the '60%' and '0%' on list cards are white or green micro-text inside thin bars and fail contrast. Put the value beside the bar

Document type is shown by pink/red dots ('PDF', 'Source file') and list status by green or grey dots. A red dot reads as an error and the meaning rests on colour alone; use neutral file-type icons with text
The selected or hovered card is marked only by blue title text and a faint shadow. Add a visible 2px focus/selected outline and make sure keyboard focus looks the same
Filenames (StBALV23040.D86, [NUMMER_001]_leer.X83) and 'GAEB 90' are light grey monospace at ~11px, well under 4.5:1. Darken them and enlarge to 12-13px

Upload, new-folder and import actions appear twice (top bar 'New Subfolder', 'Upload', 'Import CSV' and the page header 'Upload Files', 'New subfolder', 'New List'). For screen-reader and keyboard users this doubles the tab stops; keep one set
Seven header buttons in one row plus a ~16px kebab will not fit at tablet or phone width. Collapse the secondary actions into a labelled 'More' menu with at least 44px touch targets
Document card blurbs use grey 11px text clamped to two lines, which makes them hard to read. Raise the contrast or drop the blurb
Every card's kebab is a ~16px target with no accessible name

On mobile the ledger is a desktop table that scrolls sideways: Kurztext is truncated after about 12 characters, and Menge, Einheitspreis and Gesamt are off-screen, so the core task can't be done. Render the rows as stacked cards (title, OZ, qty stepper, total right-aligned) below about 640px

The mobile list tab is cut off ('[ORT_024'), the breadcrumb wraps over three lines, and the header actions wrap into ragged rows. Shorten the breadcrumb to a back link and move secondary actions into a menu

The row trash and kebab icons are ~16px, light grey, have no label and sit right next to each other, making a destructive mis-tap likely. Enlarge them to at least 24px (44px touch), add aria-labels and move delete into the menu
The quantity stepper's −/+ buttons are ~24px with pale grey glyphs (<3:1 non-text contrast). Darken the glyphs, enlarge the buttons, and label them 'Decrease/Increase quantity for <OZ>'
The OZ numbers ('OZ: 1.1.1') are light grey monospace at ~10px and fail AA. They are the primary identifier for an estimator, so give them full contrast

Budget status is a green pill on a green-tinted panel, and the inactive threshold tabs ('Caution (75%)' and others) look like plain text, so their state isn't discernible. Add a visible selected state and aria-selected, and don't rely on the mint fill
The carousel dots and '-/3', plus the 24px prev/next chevrons in the budget panel, have no labels and are tiny targets. Replace them with labelled buttons, or remove the carousel
Category chips truncate ('Baustelleneinrichtung ...') with no tooltip, so the full name is unavailable to keyboard and screen-reader users. Expose it via title or aria-label, or wrap the text

The field labels (KURZTEXT, MENGE, EINHEIT, EINHEITSPREIS €, KATEGORIE, LANGTEXT) are 10-11px uppercase grey with letter-spacing, below 4.5:1. Use 12-13px sentence case at #4b5563 or darker, programmatically tied to the inputs
'Reset changes' and the footer note 'Changes are saved in this browser' are very faint (~2:1). If the button is disabled, say why. Otherwise give it full contrast
The close X is a ~16px pale glyph in the top-right corner. Make it at least 32px with an aria-label, and confirm Esc and the focus trap work, returning focus to the row when closed
The category breadcrumb hint under the select is ~10px light grey and truncated with '…'. Raise the contrast and let it wrap
The OZ eyebrow ('OZ: 1.1.1') is grey 10px monospace with low contrast
The Gesamt read-only field looks like an input (bordered box). Style it as static text or mark it aria-readonly so it isn't mistaken for an editable field
The drawer is a fixed ~510px wide while the page behind keeps its full layout. On narrow screens it should become a full-screen sheet with sticky Save/Close
The Langtext textarea keeps hard line breaks and grows a tiny resize handle. Give it a larger handle or auto-grow, and make its focus ring clearly visible

The 'Usage of cap' percentages are white 9px text inside 8px bars (66%, 60%, 86% on orange ~2:1). Put the percentage as text beside the bar, and convey the 86% warning with a word or icon as well as orange
Sortable column headers show only faint grey up/down glyphs, and only TOTAL shows an active arrow. Expose aria-sort, darken the inactive glyphs to at least 3:1 and enlarge the header click targets
Filenames under the list names (Angebot AN24-0305.D84, LV-Positionen.docx) are light grey 11px monospace and fail AA
The 'Σ €3,836,638.94' sum next to the title is grey monospace with low contrast, yet it is the screen's key number. Make it full-contrast, larger, proportional tabular numerals
Row kebabs are ~16px targets with no labels. It is also unclear whether the whole row is a link; make the row focusable with a visible focus ring
A 6-column table with fixed widths won't fit on mobile. Plan a stacked row layout (name, folder subtitle, total right, cap bar below)
The two RINGSCHLUSS rows are identical apart from the grey filename, so screen-reader users can't tell them apart. Add a distinguishing accessible name
The empty-state dashed border and the archive icon are very pale (<3:1 non-text contrast). Darken them, or drop the border and rely on whitespace
The help text refers to 'its menu (⋮)' using a tiny glyph that low-vision users can't match to the real control. Write it as 'the More actions menu'
'Select' and the sort control show on an empty view, giving dead tab stops. Hide or disable them with aria-disabled when the view has 0 items
'New Folder' makes no sense on Archived (you can't create into an archive). Remove it to cut confusing actions
The '0 Folders' badge is grey on light grey with low contrast
The empty-state body text is ~12px grey. Raise it to 14px at >=4.5:1
The trash icon and dashed border are pale grey with non-text contrast under 3:1
The empty-state body copy is ~12px muted grey. Raise it to 14px at >=4.5:1
This header has no item-count badge or actions while Archived does, so the same type of view is inconsistent and screen-reader landmarks differ. Align the header pattern
State the retention policy (e.g. 'Items are deleted after 30 days') so users know the consequences without relying on assumptions
The global grid/list toggle and Upload File stay active on an empty Trash view. Hide controls that do nothing here
Result subtitles (filenames, '1 lists · LV 152516 ·…', 'OZ 1.1.70 · Rohbau') are light grey monospace at ~10-11px and fail 4.5:1. Use proportional 12px at #6b7280 or darker
The footer hints ('↑↓ navigate', '↵ open', '3,052 positions indexed') and the 'Esc' key cap are ~10px pale grey. Raise their contrast and size
The section headers (FOLDERS, LISTS, POSITIONS) are 10px uppercase grey. Make sure they are announced as group labels (role=group with aria-labelledby)
The active result is shown by a pale lavender fill plus a tiny ↵ glyph. Strengthen it to at least 3:1 against the other rows, or add a left accent bar, and use aria-activedescendant
The matched query text ('Beton') isn't highlighted in the results. Add a bold or underline match highlight that doesn't rely on colour
The modal is fixed at ~575px and floats mid-screen. On mobile it should be full-width or full-height with the input pinned at the top and 44px rows
The heavy background blur makes the context unreadable. The dimmed overlay is fine, but confirm the background gets aria-hidden or inert

Upload appears 4 times and subfolder 3 times ('New Subfolder', 'Upload', 'Import CSV', '+ Upload Files', '+ Create Subfolder', 'Import Item Lists & CSVs', 'Add Nested Subfolder', 'Create Blank List'), which bloats the tab order to 12+ stops. Keep one primary and one secondary action
'Supports GAEB .X81–.X86 / .D81–.D86, .CSV, .JSON and .PDF' is ~10px pale grey and fails AA, though it is critical info. Raise it to 13px at >=4.5:1
The 'Quick actions:' label and 'or drop files anywhere into this window' are low-contrast grey. Also give the drag-and-drop zone a keyboard-accessible equivalent (it currently relies on the button)
The 'Empty' badge is grey monospace on light grey with low contrast. It also duplicates the heading; remove it
The dashed drop-zone border is pale (<3:1). Strengthen it, and add a clearly visible dragover state

The header here is a boxed breadcrumb strip unlike every other screen's breadcrumb and H1 pattern, and there is no real H1 for the folder name. Restore the standard heading so screen-reader users get a page title
The toast 'Created folder "Legal & Compliance"' must be announced via role=status/aria-live, and it overlaps the card edge at the bottom right. Keep it clear of content
Seven or more buttons across the header won't fit on tablet or mobile. Collapse them into one 'Add' menu

global_issues: Drop text inside progress bars: white or green 9px percentages inside 8px bars fail WCAG 1.4.3 on every screen. Put the value beside the bar in full-contrast text, and expose bars as role=progressbar with aria-valuenow and an accessible label

Muted text is too light throughout (breadcrumbs, placeholders, OZ numbers, filenames, uppercase section and field labels, footer hints): ~#9ca3af at 10-11px is roughly 2.5:1. Set the muted token to at least #6b7280 on white (4.5:1) and use 12px as the minimum size

Status is colour-only: green, orange, grey and red dots and orange text signal budget health and file type. Pair every status colour with a word ('Near cap', 'Over cap') and an icon, and keep file-type dots neutral

Icon-only controls (kebab, row trash, grid/list toggle, sidebar collapse, tab '+', drawer close, carousel chevrons, mobile upload) are ~16-24px with no visible name. Make them at least 24x24px on desktop and 44x44px on touch, with aria-labels and tooltips
Mobile list ledger: the desktop table overflows sideways and hides prices, quantities and totals. Build a stacked card or row layout below 640px, and shorten the breadcrumb and header actions
Use proportional tabular numerals for money instead of monospace. Keep key totals full-contrast and large; the grey mono sums (Σ, cap values) currently read as disabled
Visible focus: no focus rings are evident on cards, rows, chips or the palette. Add a consistent 2px focus-visible outline (>=3:1) and make the selected card or row state match it
Remove duplicated actions (top bar plus page header plus empty state). They multiply tab stops and screen-reader noise; keep one primary action per screen and put the rest in a labelled 'More' menu
